comparisons.name: back-forward-light
comparisons.description: Back (enabled) and Forward (disabled) in the key Finder window, Aqua. The chevrons are drawn to the measured geometry, so nothing is masked.

comparisons.name: back-forward-dark
comparisons.description: Back (enabled) and Forward (disabled) in the key Finder window, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: inactive-light
comparisons.description: Back, Forward and the sidebar button in the inactive Safari window, Aqua. The sidebar glyph is a stand-in drawing and is masked.

comparisons.name: inactive-dark
comparisons.description: Back, Forward and the sidebar button in the inactive Safari window, Dark Aqua. The sidebar glyph is masked.

comparisons.name: inactive-light-whole
comparisons.description: As inactive-light with nothing masked (Back, Forward and the sidebar button), so the stand-in sidebar glyph is scored too.

comparisons.name: inactive-dark-whole
comparisons.description: As inactive-dark with nothing masked (Back, Forward and the sidebar button), so the stand-in sidebar glyph is scored too.

comparisons.name: console-info-light
comparisons.description: The middle of Console's Info button, Aqua: a toggle that is on and shows it by its glyph (pressedStyle tint), the plain bezel's top and bottom edges and the tinted disc. Whole crop; the letter in the disc is a stand-in drawing.

comparisons.name: console-info-light-disc
comparisons.description: As console-info-light with the letter masked, to score the bezel and the disc's place, size and tint.

comparisons.name: console-info-dark
comparisons.description: The middle of Console's Info button, Dark Aqua. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: console-info-dark-disc
comparisons.description: As console-info-dark with the letter masked.

comparisons.name: keychain-buttons-light
comparisons.description: The two toolbar buttons of Keychain Access, Aqua, laid out by their bezels (frame bezel) from 78 pt with the toolbar's 8 pt gap: the fills start half a point later, behind the hairline border. Whole crop; the two glyphs are stand-in drawings.

comparisons.name: keychain-buttons-light-bezels
comparisons.description: As keychain-buttons-light with the two glyphs masked, to score where the two bezels stand.

comparisons.name: keychain-buttons-dark
comparisons.description: The two toolbar buttons of Keychain Access, Dark Aqua, from the same layout: without a border the fills start at 78 and 110 pt. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: keychain-buttons-dark-bezels
comparisons.description: As keychain-buttons-dark with the two glyphs masked.

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: A pressed toolbar button, Aqua: Safari's Share button while its menu is open, the upper 50 x 18 pt of the toolbar, above where the open menu's shadow darkens the capture. The bezel's darker fill inside the resting border, on the title bar's material. At 1x the bezel's half-point border and first rows lie on fractions of a pixel. The glyph is masked: it is a stand-in for Safari's.

comparisons.name: pressed-dark
comparisons.description: A pressed toolbar button, Dark Aqua: Safari's Share button while its menu is open, the upper 50 x 18 pt of the toolbar. The bezel's lighter fill, without a border, on the title bar's material. The glyph is masked.
